title: Biased probability level
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube, and let $\alpha$ be a real number with $0<\alpha<1$. The biased probability level of $f$ at $\alpha$ is the unique real parameter selected by the condition that the associated biased minus-probability polynomial equals zero.
caveat: The defining polynomial and its equation are not included in the supplied definitions, so their precise mathematical content cannot be stated here.
